chunks.text: Lodging taxes are not included in the CONUS per diem rate. The Federal Travel Regulation 301-11.16 states that in CONUS, lodging taxes paid by the federal traveler are reimbursable as a miscellaneous travel expense limited to the taxes on reimbursable lodging costs.
On the first and last travel day, Federal employees are only eligible for 75 percent of the total M&IE rate for their temporary duty travel location.
